questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}& \text{题设方程右端的自由项为}f(x)=P_{m}(x)e^{ix}, \text{其中}P_{m}(x)=3x+1,\lambda=0.\\& \text{对应的齐次方程的特征方程为}r^{2}-2r-3=0,\text{特征根为}r_{1}=-1,r_{2}=3.\\& \text{由于}\lambda=0 \text{不是特征方程的根，所以就设特解为}y^{*}=b_{0}x+b_{1}.\\& \text{把它代入题设方程,得}-3b_{0}x-2b_{0}-3b_{1}=3x+1,\\& \quad\begin{cases}-3b_{0}=3\\-2b_{0}-3b_{1}=1\end{cases}\text{解得}\begin{cases}b_{0}=-1\\b_{1}=1/\sqrt{3}\end{cases}\\& \text{比较系数得}y^{*}=-x+\frac{1}{3}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解析：} & \text{由}2r^{2}+5r=0, \text{解得}r_{1}=0,r_{2}=-5/2, \text{故对应的齐次方程的通解为}Y=C_{1}+C_{2}e^{-\frac{5}{2}x} \text{ 因} \\ & f(x)=5x^{2}-2x-1, \lambda=0 \text{是特征方程的单根，故设}y^{*}=x(b_{0}x^{2}+b_{1}x+b_{2}) \text{是原方程的一个特解，代入} \\ & \text{方程并整理，得}15b_{0}x^{2}+(12b_{0}+10b_{1})x+4b_{1}+5b_{2}=5x^{2}-2x-1, \text{比较系数得} \\ & b_{0}=1/3,b_{1}=-3/5,b_{2}=7/25, \text{即}y^{*}=\frac{1}{3}x^{3}-\frac{3}{5}x^{2}+\frac{7}{25}x \text{故原方程的通解为} \\ & y=Y+y^{*}=C_{1}+C_{2}e^{-\frac{5}{2}x}+\frac{1}{3}x^{3}-\frac{3}{5}x^{2}+\frac{7}{25}x \end{aligned}
